استبينوا (form X)
# اُسْتُبِينُوا (ustubīnū) /us.tu.biː.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَبَانَ (istabāna)
# اِسْتَبِينُوا (istabīnū) /is.ta.biː.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبَانَ (istabāna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
